answer_1.quote: We consider a range of NLG evaluation datasets which have available ground-truth scores. For summary evaluation we use SummEval ... For dialogue response generation, we use TopicalChat ... For question difficulty ranking, we use CMCQRD ... Lastly, for story evaluation, we use HANNA ...

answer_2.quote: Scoring Methods Several different methods of mapping a set of comparisons to scores are used in this paper, categorized into binary decision-based or probability-based.

answer_3.quote: One such practical application is in Natural Language Generation evaluation, where LLMs can be prompted to assess the quality of texts for particular attributes.
